data.long_meaning: The name Gianina is derived from the Greek word 'Giannos', meaning 'God is gracious'. The name Gianina carries the meaning “Joyful, Gracious, Gentle” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gianina usually hope their child will grow to embody joyful, gracious, gentle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
